[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Advisor/Legends|Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]] was '''captured''' in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] allied privateers at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. The Rebel affiliated crew led by [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij]] of the former Imperial [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]'', managed to convince Veshiv that they were present to take him to his next destination. Veshiv agreed and left his ship, the ''[[Empire Forever]]'', and was captured, being turned over to the Rebels eventually. It was in large part due to Veshiv's capture as well as the failure to stop it that [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] orchestrated the [[Battle of Andalia]], which resulted in [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]]'s cyborgification.
